map.每股账面价值 BVPS =（股东权益总额 − 优先股权益）÷ 流通在外普通股股数: Book value per share BVPS = (total shareholders' equity − preferred stock equity) ÷ number of common shares outstanding; it reflects the net assets behind each share and is often used in value investing and in judging a break below book value; it is the counterpart of the price-to-book ratio PB = price ÷ BVPS.
map.BVPS 反映账面净资产支撑。: BVPS reflects the book net-asset backing.
map.与市价之比即市净率倒数。: Its ratio to the market price is the reciprocal of the price-to-book ratio.
map.📚 深度解析：每股净资产（BVPS）: 📚 Deep Dive: Book Value per Share (BVPS)
map.计算每股对应的股东权益账面价值。: Compute the book value of shareholders' equity per share.
map.与股价比较得 P/B 估值。: Compare it with the share price to get a P/B valuation.
map.分红/增发/回购后股本变动时重算。: Recalculate whenever the share count changes after a dividend, a placement or a buyback.
map.BVPS = 股东权益/总股本 = 10 亿 / 2 亿 = 5.00 元/股。: BVPS = shareholders' equity / total shares = 1.0bn / 200m = 5.00 CNY per share. If the share price is 30 CNY, then P/B = 6.
map.回购后股本减少: Share count falls after a buyback
map.净资产 10 亿、回购注销后股本 1.8 亿股：BVPS = 10/1.8 ≈: Net assets 1.0bn, share count 180m after a buyback and cancellation: BVPS = 10/1.8 ≈ 5.56 CNY per share, higher than before the buyback (the numerator is unchanged while the denominator shrinks).
map.净资产含少数股东权益吗？: Does net assets include minority interests?
map.通常用归属于母公司股东的净资产（剔除少数股东），口径需与 P/B 分母一致，否则: Usually the net assets attributable to the parent's shareholders are used (excluding minority interests); the basis must match the denominator of P/B, otherwise it is distorted.
map.会。分红减少留存收益（净资产）且不减少股本，BVPS 下降；但股价除权同步下调，: Yes. A dividend reduces retained earnings (net assets) without reducing the share count, so BVPS falls; but the share price adjusts down on the ex-dividend date, so P/B is unchanged.
